Fixes from the first round of 2.0 feedback.

**Windows:** `Deviload-2.0.1-setup.exe`, or accept the update prompt in 2.0.0.

**Mac (test build):** `Deviload-2.0.1-macos-test.zip`, unzip, move to Applications and run `xattr -cr /Applications/Deviload.app` once.

What's changed

- The queue and the library are separate: remove one task at a time, and clearing the queue no longer empties the library, which has its own remove and clear
- A playlist downloaded before now says so instead of quietly finishing, and "Download again" brings back files you deleted
- Pick a default save folder in Settings; the folder button opens the folder you actually save to
- Devil Cut: long videos no longer lag, the timeline is taller and resizable, and a clip's sound can be detached and moved on its own track
- The window can be moved while Devil Cinema or another dialog is open: drag the dialog header or the dark area around it
- Smaller fixes: library cards no longer jump under the mouse, the phone dialog fits small windows, the tour mascot keeps its head

Full changelog: https://github.com/Pronexsteam/deviload/compare/v2.0.0...v2.0.1
